_note: Full section as it stands in the source term bank (by Dr Veamoniti Lautaha). Hardware is fully bilingual. Software is the least complete section in the whole document - about 40% of entries (Algorithm, Compiler, Interpreter, Antivirus, Spreadsheet, Word Processor, Graphic Design Software, Video Editing Software, Gaming Software, Backup, Encryption) have no Tongan term coined yet at all. Left blank deliberately rather than guessed.

entries.en_definition: An electronic device for storing and processing data, typically in binary form, according to instructions given to it in a variable program.
entries.to_definition: Ko ha me'a-ngaue fakae'uhila 'oku ngaue'aki ki hono tauhi pea mo faka-hokohoko 'ae ngaahi okooko 'ihe fuo 'oe taha-pea-moe-noa - pe koe "mo'ui pe mate" 'ae 'uhila 'o faka-tatau kiha tu'utu'uni 'a ngaahi me'a kuo tufunga'i makehe mo lahi.

entries.en_definition: The "brain" of the computer, responsible for executing instructions.
entries.to_definition: Koe 'atamai 'oe ahuoma 'oku ne fakahokohoko 'ae ngahi tu'utu'uni kuo fa'u.

entries.en_definition: Temporary storage for data the computer is actively using.
entries.to_definition: Koe tauhi'anga tu'utu'uni ngaue 'oku lolotonga faka'aonga'i 'e he ahuoma.

entries.en_definition: Permanent storage for data and programs - a data storage device that uses magnetic platters to store and retrieve digital information.
entries.to_definition: Koe feitu'u pau 'oku tauhi ai 'ae ngaahi tala 'ihe fuo faka'uhila pea moe ngaahi me'a kuo tufunga'i makehe mo lahi.

entries.en_definition: The main circuit board connecting all components.
entries.to_definition: Koe tefito'i papa faka-hokongaue 'oku ne faka-fehokotaki 'ae ngahi va'afekau'aki kotoa 'oe ahuoma.

entries.en_definition: A hardware component responsible for rendering and displaying images, videos, and animations on your computer monitor.
entries.to_definition: Koe me'angaue fa'o'anga 'ata, lea, pe faka-tata 'oku ne fatongia'aki 'a hono faka-hokohoko'i 'enau fotu mai, 'asi mai, pea mo honau ngahi fuo moe lanu takitaha 'ihe me'a faka-'ali'ali 'ata.

entries.en_definition: The screen that displays information from your computer.
entries.to_definition: Koe me'angaue faka'ali'ali 'ata, fuo, lanu, mata'itohi, pea moe le'o.

entries.en_definition: Input device for typing text and commands.
entries.to_definition: Koe me'angaue fakahu mata'itohi moe ngaahi fakahinohino 'ae ahuoma 'aki hano lomi'i ki nautolu 'ihe papapule.

entries.en_definition: Input device for pointing and clicking.
entries.to_definition: Koe me'angaue talafatongia 'oku faka'aonga'i ki hono tataki mo hono lomi'i 'oe ngaahi fiema'u 'ae ahuoma.

entries.en_definition: Outputs information onto paper.
entries.to_definition: Ko hono fakafuo mai 'ae ngaahi fakahinohino 'otulea 'ihe tohi'anga.

entries.en_definition: Inputs images and documents into the computer.
entries.to_definition: Ko hono fakahu atu 'ae ngaahi 'ataa pea moe ngaahi tohi'anga fakamatala kihe ahuoma.

entries.en_definition: Connects the computer to the internet.
entries.to_definition: Koe me'angaue 'oku ne fatongia'aki 'a hono fakafehokotaki 'ae ahuoma kihe ngaluope.

entries.en_definition: Distributes internet connection to multiple devices.
entries.to_definition: Koe me'angaue 'oku ne fatongia'aki 'a hono fakafehokotaki'i 'oe {ope, kupengaope, pe ngaluope} kiha ngahi lukioma 'oku lahi 'aupito 'ihe feitu'u pau.

entries.en_definition: Standard port for connecting peripherals.
entries.to_definition: Koe hoko pe konga angamaheni 'ihe ahuoma 'oku faka'aonga'i ki hono fakakau pea fakafehokotaki'i 'oe ngaahi kongokonga tanaki mai 'oe ahuoma.

entries.en_definition: Connects to wired internet.
entries.to_definition: Koe feitu'u 'ihe ahuoma 'oku tufunga'i ke hoko ki ai 'ae fue pe kafa 'oe {ope-ngaluope-kupengaope}.

entries.en_definition: Processes audio output.
entries.to_definition: Koe {me'a-feitu'u-naunau-koloa} 'eni 'oku tufunga'i kene tokanga'i 'ae fakahokohoko 'a hono tuku atu 'ae ongo 'o ha lea pe hiva.

entries.en_definition: The enclosure that houses the computer's components.
entries.to_definition: Koe 'uunime'a 'oku ne kofukofu'i 'ae ngaahi kongokonga 'oe ahuoma.

entries.en_definition: Provides electricity to the computer.
entries.to_definition: Koe konga 'oe ahuoma 'oku ne tauhi mo tufaki mei ai 'ae ivi faka'uhila.

entries.en_definition: Prevents overheating.
entries.to_definition: Koe konga 'oe ahuoma 'oku ne fakamokomoko 'ae ahuoma ke 'oua 'e fu'u mafana.

entries.en_definition: Reads and writes data on optical discs like CDs, DVDs, and Blu-ray discs using a laser.
entries.to_definition: Koe konga 'oe ahuoma 'oku ne fatongia'aki 'a hono lau mo tohi 'ae okooko kihe ngaahi 'uunimaka kuo tufunga'i ke hoko koe tauhi'anga okooko mo fakamatala 'ae ahuoma.

entries.en_definition: Captures video and images.
entries.to_definition: Ko hono fatongia ko hono hiki 'ae ngaahi 'ata pea moe fotunga.

entries.en_definition: Captures audio input.
entries.to_definition: Ko hono fatongai ko hono hiki 'oe ngaahi le'o.

entries.en_definition: Output audio.
entries.to_definition: Koe {me'a-feitu'u-naunau-koloa} 'eni 'oku tufunga'i kene fakafuo mai 'ae ongo 'o ha lea pe hiva.

entries.en_definition: Firmware that initializes the computer at startup and controls hardware components such as hard disks, keyboards, and display screens.
entries.to_definition: Koe 'uunima'u 'oku ne tataki, fakahinohino, mo kamata'i 'ae hono fakamo'ui 'ae ahuoma.

entries.en_definition: Physical connections for peripherals.
entries.to_definition: Koe feitu'u 'ihe lukioma 'oku tufunga'i ke hoko ki ai 'ae fue pe kafa 'oe ngaahi konga makehe 'oe ahuoma.

Programs that run on a computer.
A collection of data stored under a name.

Executes code line by line.

Software to protect against viruses.

Software that allows hardware to communicate with the OS.
Organized collection of data.
Software for organizing and analyzing data in rows and columns.
Software for creating and editing text documents.
Programs for creating visual content.
Programs for creating and editing videos.
Programs for playing games.
Using online resources instead of local storage.
A copy of data for recovery purposes.
Converting data into a secret code.
Facts and figures processed or stored by a computer.
Looking for specific information within a system.
